title: FleetGo Ops v2
brief: Operations console for FleetGo, v2 only: the live map, following and replay, each carrying its own detail in an accordion rail — unit detail, the current trip, and the replayable days and trips. Alerts are scoped to the vehicle in view. Settings keeps rules, zones, routing and history; watchlist lives in the units panel and personal notification preferences live in routing.

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Live map + assistant rail
artboards.tradeoff: The surface that cannot be language: map, two mode entries, critical-zone band and the agent in a rail — whose alerts are scoped to the selected unit and whose UNIT section carries the whole vehicle detail, so opening a screen to see one vehicle is no longer a destination

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Following — camera locked
artboards.tradeoff: Camera locked to one unit, with a full-width dock holding only what the map needs and a TRIP section that resolves the current connection on a strip: started 06:12 -> now 12:13 = 6 h 01 m of trip = 4 h 13 driving + 1 h 48 across four stops

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Replay — time travel over stored samples
artboards.tradeoff: Time travel over stored samples with a REPLAY section that answers what can be replayed: five days, day totals that equal the sum of the listed trips (312 km, 4 h 13, 4 stops, 1 240 samples), and a Replay affordance per trip

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Alerts queue
artboards.tradeoff: Two lanes that must stay glanceable: alerts needing a person (acknowledge, with audit) and data problems that belong to Platform and are not yours to resolve

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Rules
artboards.tradeoff: Plain language in, conditions out: rules written as sentences, an audited active list, and one settings shell whose sidebar now leads to a designed view at every destination

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Zones
artboards.tradeoff: The map IS the editor: five zones drawn to scale-less geometry with a live "units inside" counter, a numbered-vertex drawing in progress, and the assistant allowed only to draft a dashed polygon the human accepts, adjusts or discards — because a boundary 200 m off changes who gets woken up

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Routing
artboards.tradeoff: Team level, never mixed with personal: who hears an alert, on which channel, and the escalation ladder that stops on acknowledge rather than resolve

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · History
artboards.tradeoff: An append-only audit record, not a chat log: who, when, before → after and why — the agent may propose a change and can never write the line

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Keyboard — the shortcuts sheet
artboards.tradeoff: The keymap back without the palette: an overlay opened with ? over the map, 34 bindings grouped by scope (global, G-chords, map, queue, replay, device) with the collisions resolved in writing — because language goes to ⌘K and keys go to what you can see

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · Modes (reference, not a screen)
artboards.tradeoff: Why follow, replay and device inspection are states of one map: the fold/drop ledger for the ten v1 boards, the show/hide matrix of the three modes, and the test every future screen must pass
